name: proof-parts-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-parts.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; export GDP_LEAN_NATIVE=0; BAPA_SPLIT_TINY_DIR="$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tiny" bun test research/bapa/proof-parts.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; for mode in none frame mono lin both; do cd "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tiny/$mode"; lake build > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lean-$mode.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lean-$mode.log" FamilyParts.lean tiny*.lean > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/axioms-$mode.log" 2>&1; done; cd "$ROOT"; printf '%s\n' 'feat(lean): split retained counted families without search' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1
